```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Ancestry", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

ancestry_colors <- c("#add8e6", "#FEF5C3", "#fdc0cb")
black_colors <- c("black", "black", "black")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}

delta_diff <- function(data) {
  pan <- data[data$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
  lin  <- data[data$Reference == "Linear", ]
  
  merged <- merge(pan, lin, by = "Donor_ID", suffixes = c("_Pangenome", "_Linear"))
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Donor_ID        = merged$Donor_ID,
    Ancestry        = merged$Ancestry_Pangenome,
    Delta_Recall    = merged$Recall_Pangenome - merged$Recall_Linear,
    Delta_Precision = merged$Precision_Pangenome - merged$Precision_Linear,
    Delta_F1_Score  = merged$F1_Score_Pangenome - merged$F1_Score_Linear
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Process
```{r}
strelka <- rename_col(strelka)
strelka <- as_numeric(strelka)

delta_strelka <- delta_diff(strelka)

delta_strelka$Ancestry <- factor(
  delta_strelka$Ancestry,
  levels = c("AA_Patients", "EA_Patients", "EAA_Patients")
)

strelka_long <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(delta_strelka$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Ancestry = rep(delta_strelka$Ancestry, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("Delta_F1_Score", "Delta_Precision", "Delta_Recall"), 
               each = nrow(delta_strelka)),
  Value  = c(delta_strelka$Delta_F1_Score, 
             delta_strelka$Delta_Precision, 
             delta_strelka$Delta_Recall)
)
```

# Plot
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
jitterdodge <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)

set.seed(1)
boxplot_output <- ggplot(strelka_long, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Ancestry)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
    alpha = 0.2,                
    fill = "grey"                
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "solid", 
    color = "black", 
    size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6, 
    position = dodge) +
  labs(
    # title = plot_title, 
    x = element_blank(), 
    y = expression(paste(Delta, " Metric Percentage (%)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Delta_F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
    "Delta_Precision" = "Precision",
    "Delta_Recall" = "Recall")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-64, 64),
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ancestry_colors,
    name = "Ancestry",
    labels = c(
      "AA_Patients" = "African",
      "EA_Patients" = "European",
      "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = black_colors,
    name = "Ancestry",
    labels = c(
      "AA_Patients" = "African",
      "EA_Patients" = "European",
      "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    aes(color = Ancestry),
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = jitterdodge) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    # legend.position.inside = c(0.92, 0.15),
    # legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    # legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    # legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black"),
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = "Strelka Pangenome - Linear",
    size = 7,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "grey", 
    size = 0.6)

boxplot_output
```

# Save Pangenome Plot
```{r}
ggsave("./plot/supp4_ancestry_boxplot_strelka_delta_pangenome_linear.pdf", boxplot_output, width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Ploting Template for F1 Score Only
```{r}
f1_boxplot <- function(data, label, lim_low, lim_high, bg_fill, y_break, vjust) {

set.seed(1)
ggplot(data, aes(Ancestry, Delta_F1_Score, fill = Ancestry)) + 
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "solid", 
    color = "black", 
    size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.6) +
  labs(
    # title = plot_title, 
    x = "F1 Score", 
    y = expression(paste(Delta, " Delta Percentage (%)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "AA_Patients" = "African",
    "EA_Patients" = "European",
    "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.3))
    )  +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(lim_low, lim_high),
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, y_break)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ancestry_colors) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    # legend.position = legend,
    # legend.position.inside = c(pos_x, pos_y),
    # legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    # legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    # legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = bg_fill),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    # axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),  
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black"),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = label,
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = vjust
  )

}
```
